control.description-key: Virtual PCF: form-bound viewer for the shared CommunicationTimeline polling message timeline (task 060) on the OOB sprk_communication and sprk_communicationthread forms. Renders persisted messages (email + chat interleaved), unread indicator, and compose/send box, polling the BFF via @spaarke/auth. No Code Page host, no FCC swap (ADR-026 Path-A exception; task 061).

property.name: clientAppId
property.description-key: Azure AD application (client) ID for PCF MSAL authentication

property.name: bffAppId
property.description-key: BFF API application ID for OAuth scope construction

property.name: showVersionFooter
property.description-key: When true (default), displays the PCF version footer.
